title: Context WorkUnit Draft - Require behavior proof and live-test validation plan before implementation
objective: Normalize prompt into a bounded context WorkUnit draft: require behavior proof and live-test validation plan before implementation.
why: AIDE compiles raw prompts into bounded WorkUnits before execution.
forbidden_paths: target repositories unless target-local queue authorizes work
implementation_outline: require behavior proof and live-test validation plan before implementation

acceptance: WorkUnit scope is bounded and repo-grounded.
